name: Superside
long_description:
Superside is the world's leading AI-first creative partner for enterprise teams. We help marketing and creative teams at brands like Amazon, Microsoft, Reddit, DoorDash and Intuit scale high-quality, on-brand creative without the cost or complexity of traditional agencies.

We are not a traditional agency, a freelance marketplace or a standalone AI tool. Superside combines a global team of expert designers, writers, motion artists and strategists with AI-powered workflows and Superspace — our proprietary creative management platform — all delivered through one flexible subscription. 

With 800+ team members across 70+ countries, 200,000+ projects delivered and 90%+ of our creatives AI-certified, we cover every creative service from ad creative and video to motion, branding and web design.

Since Y Combinator W16, Superside has raised capital from Luxor Capital, Prosus Ventures, Freestyle Capital, Slack Fund, Sam Altman, High Alpha and Alliance Ventures.
